component.name: PIC — Personal Image Catalogue
component.summary: Browse, organise and edit your photo collection

description.p: PIC is a native photo manager inspired by Picasa and iPhoto. Browse local folders and network shares, organise your library, and work with your photos in one application.

ul.li: Browse photo grids and open images in the full-screen viewer.
Organise photos with albums, favourites, ratings and search.
Adjust photos with editing tools and create photo collages.
Browse SMB and NFS shares using direct network transports.
Choose an appearance theme for your workspace.

screenshot.caption: Browse and organise your photo library

description.p: Release Candidate 3 improves large-library browsing, Folder view performance, five-star ratings, multiple libraries, photo viewing, editing, imports, network browsing, colour management and Linux packaging.
